parameters.description: Repaint this same defender from a HIGHER orthographic camera, looking down about 49 degrees, matching an Into the Breach 4:3 diamond board. Face southeast. Show much more helmet top, shoulder tops, shield upper rim and boot insteps; foreshorten torso and legs. Preserve the character design, colors, shield and sword, chunky Warcraft/Kingdom Rush simple pixel art. Plain helmet, no plume. Entire body and gear inside 64x64 with 3px clear margin. Transparent background, no ground or shadow.
